published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: onERC721Received() creates two pledge rights in the intermediate state, resulting in the same NFT being bound to two different pledge rights.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Set a _marketBuyFlow flag to indicate that the contract is conducting a market purchase operation.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: There is a lack of a flag for indicating that the purchase operation of the contract is underway.
